posts.title: There is a Discord now, if you want to talk with other writers using Inkgrove
posts.body: It is the place to ask how something works, share how a book is going, talk through a bug, and hear about a new version before it reaches the app, and it is the quickest way to tell me what you would like Inkgrove to do next.

posts.title: There is a newsletter now, if you want the longer version
posts.body: It covers writing and the building of Inkgrove at more length than a release note allows, and since it is only just beginning you would be reading from the first one.

posts.title: Videos about the craft, and about building this in the open
posts.body: There is a channel where I talk through writing and through what goes into Inkgrove, including the parts of drafting that tend to catch people out.
